name: Canvas Write
description: Put a result on a canvas as a new layer, straight onto the head: a new revision is made from the one Canvas Region read and the head moves to it, so the layer is there to keep, hide or delete (Undo removes it too). When something else moved the head while this ran, the layer is added onto the head as it is now (layers only add), and the node reports the head it landed on. Only when that is impossible (the canvas changed size) does the new revision stay as a candidate, with a warning and accepted off. For a review step, turn Keep as candidate on: the head then never moves and the result waits for you to compare and accept or drop (fugue canvas candidates, diff, accept, drop). The picture is resized to the stitch's box and the new layer holds it whole, with a layer mask that blends it in: the mask softened outward by Blend pixels, as Stitch does (turn Bake the blend on to put the blend into the layer's own pixels instead, as before). The layer is named from the prompt that made the picture, else Fill 1, Fill 2 and so on.

inputs.name: canvas
inputs.label: Canvas
inputs.description: The canvas and the revision the work started from: Canvas Region's canvas output.

inputs.name: image
inputs.label: Image
inputs.description: The picture to place. With a stitch it must have the region's shape to within 2%; without one it covers the whole canvas.

inputs.name: stitch
inputs.label: Stitch
inputs.description: Where the picture goes, and the mask to blend through: Canvas Region's stitch output.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.label: Mask
inputs.description: The mask to blend through, at the canvas's size. Without one, the stitch's, and without a stitch the whole picture.

inputs.name: blend
inputs.label: Blend
inputs.description: How far the edge of the mask fades outward, in canvas pixels.

inputs.name: candidate
inputs.label: Keep as candidate
inputs.description: Off (the default): the result lands on the head as a layer. On: keep the result for review: the head does not move, and the new revision waits as a candidate to accept into the head or drop.

inputs.name: bake
inputs.label: Bake the blend into the layer
inputs.description: Off: the layer is the redrawn picture whole and the blend is its layer mask, which can be turned off or edited later. On: the blend is put into the layer's pixels and there is no layer mask (the composite is the same).

inputs.name: name
inputs.label: Layer name
inputs.description: The new layer's name. Fill (the default) or empty names it from the prompt upstream (the Text Encode that made the picture), else Fill 1, Fill 2 and so on.

outputs.name: canvas
outputs.label: Canvas
outputs.description: The revision that holds the new layer.

outputs.name: accepted
outputs.label: Accepted
outputs.description: Whether the layer landed on the head (directly, or placed on a head that moved meanwhile). Off for a kept candidate.

outputs.name: head
outputs.label: Head
outputs.description: The canvas's head after the write: the revision that holds the new layer when accepted, else the head that stayed.
